reference: Despite the fan on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
sk: Napriek ventilátoru na plný výkon sa zopnutá kopa vôbec nepohla.
cz: Navzdory ventilátoru na plný výkon se sepnutá hromada vůbec nepohnula.
acceptable: {Despite|In spite of} the fan {on full|at full power|on full power|running at full power|on full blast|at full blast}, the clipped {pile|heap|stack} didn't {move|budge} at all.
The clipped {pile|heap|stack} didn't {move|budge} at all {despite|in spite of} the fan {on full|at full power|on full blast}.
{Despite|In spite of} the fan being {on full|at full power|on full blast}, the clipped {pile|heap|stack} didn't {move|budge} at all.

mistakes.text: Despite of the fan on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Despite“ sa používa bez „of“: „despite the fan“. S „of“ je len „in spite of“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Despite“ se používá bez „of“: „despite the fan“. S „of“ je jen „in spite of“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Despite” takes no “of”: “despite the fan”. Only “in spite of” has “of”.

mistakes.text: {Although|Even though} the fan on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „although“ musí nasledovať veta so slovesom; pred podstatným menom patrí „despite“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „although“ musí následovat věta se slovesem; před podstatným jménem patří „despite“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Although” needs a full clause with a verb; before a noun phrase use “despite”.

mistakes.text: {Despite|In spite of} the fan was on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „despite/in spite of“ nemôže nasledovať veta so slovesom, preto vynechaj „was“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „despite/in spite of“ nemůže následovat věta se slovesem, proto vynech „was“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Despite/In spite of” can't be followed by a clause with a verb, so leave out “was”.

mistakes.text: {Although|Even though} the fan was on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Tu sa precvičuje „despite“ s podstatným menom: „Despite the fan on full, …“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Tady se procvičuje „despite“ s podstatným jménem: „Despite the fan on full, …“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Here practise “despite” + noun phrase: “Despite the fan on full, …”.
